description:
PROBLEM (concordance / correct-by-construction): "a ground literal value" is carried by FOUR duplicative types that already disagree, plus TWO copies of one finite-or-cofinite set abstraction.

Carriers:
- MapKey {Atom, Int} -- src/types/map.rs -- type-lattice map field keys (2 kinds).
- Literal {Int, Float(f64), Binary, Atom, Bool, Nil} -- src/compiler2/body.rs -- lowered IR constants (6 kinds).
- DispatchConst {Int, FloatBits(u64), AtomName, Bool, Nil, EmptyList, Utf8Binary} -- src/dispatch_matrix/mod.rs -- dispatch/pattern constants (7 kinds).
- RuntimeTypePredicate ObservedSet element types {i64, u64 float-bits, String} -- src/runtime_type_predicate.rs.
Set containers: LiteralSet<T> (src/compiler2/types/lit_set.rs) and ObservedSet<T> (src/runtime_type_predicate.rs).

Proof they are ONE idea, already in the code:
- literal_map_key (jobs/semantic.rs:2247) is a hand-written narrowing Literal -> MapKey (keeps Int/Atom, drops Float/Binary/Bool/Nil). MapKey IS the atom/int projection of Literal.
- floats are the IDENTICAL u64 bit pattern in DispatchConst::FloatBits AND ObservedSet<u64>.
- runtime_type_predicate_intersect (types/mod.rs:1843) hand-copies LiteralSet::intersect because ObservedSet lacks the method; union truth tables identical; atoms built by copying LiteralSet fields into ObservedSet field-for-field.

FOLD (value-level, reference-model-NEUTRAL -- NO type-lattice precision change, NO behavior change):
1. One GroundValue leaf enum = lossless superset:
   Int(i64) | Float(u64 bits) | Atom(String) | Bool(bool) | Nil | EmptyList | Binary(Vec<u8>) | Utf8Binary(Vec<u8>).
   MapKey/Literal/DispatchConst deleted; each site constructs/consumes its subset via narrowing accessors. Plain enum (no interner/Types handle).
2. One finite-or-cofinite Set container: fold LiteralSet<T> + ObservedSet<T> into one generic type carrying the full method set (none/any/lit/finite/finite_len/is_none/is_any/contains/overlaps/union/intersect/neg). Serves lattice axes AND the runtime predicate.

CONFLATION GUARD -- four distinctions are LOAD-BEARING and MUST survive as distinct variants (acceptance criteria):
- Float carried as u64 BITS not f64 (Eq/Hash/Ord derivability; codegen float dispatch is bit-exact icmp at native_codegen/receive.rs:1150; Literal converts f64<->bits at its few sites, never hashes floats).
- Nil =/= EmptyList (different runtime ValueKind tags ATOM vs LIST, receive.rs:1183-1191; merging is a correctness break).
- Binary =/= Utf8Binary (raw pre-brand bytes vs UTF-8-asserted, str-typed byte-compare path).
- Bool stays its own variant (pattern-match ergonomics; not Atom("true"/"false")).

PLACEMENT: a self-contained leaf module GroundValue depends on nothing, referenced by types, fz_ir, runtime_type_predicate, dispatch_matrix, compiler2 (single crate; module cross-refs legal; a leaf avoids deepening the existing types<->fz_ir module cycle). dispatch_matrix (today zero dep on any concrete value type; generic over TypeHandle) gains one new leaf edge in the correct direction -- called out, acceptable.

WHAT GOES AWAY: 3 enum defs (MapKey, Literal, DispatchConst) + 1 container (ObservedSet) -> GroundValue + one Set (five types -> two); cross-conversion fns (literal_map_key, the as_map_key/dispatch_const_ty bridge, runtime_type_predicate_intersect, the ObservedSet<->LiteralSet field copies) become narrowing accessors or vanish. Anti-drift: the carriers can no longer disagree on encoding (they already do -- see the nil finding).

BLAST RADIUS: wide but shallow per-site -- each DispatchConst/Literal/MapKey site is a rename + variant-map; backend/codegen unaffected in shape (already bare-enum matches, no Types handle).

SUB-DAG (execute in order, one commit each):
- .1 Introduce the GroundValue leaf type (superset enum + derives + narrowing accessors), no migration; unit-test the four preserved distinctions. Blocks .3/.4/.5/.6.
- .2 Fold LiteralSet + ObservedSet into one finite-or-cofinite Set container. Blocks .6. (Independent of .1.)
- .3 Migrate MapKey -> GroundValue (delete src/types/map.rs; MapSig.fields keyed by the atom/int subset via narrowing accessor -- do NOT silently accept keys the map lattice cannot reason about). Blocked by .1.
- .4 Migrate Literal -> GroundValue (delete body::Literal; f64<->bits at its sites; keep Binary distinct from Utf8Binary; Nil stays the atom-nil VALUE). Blocked by .1.
- .5 Migrate DispatchConst -> GroundValue (delete dispatch_matrix::DispatchConst; preserve FloatBits/EmptyList/Utf8Binary verbatim; add the leaf edge). Blocked by .1.
- .6 Migrate ObservedSet members -> GroundValue + wire the unified Set into RuntimeTypePredicate. Blocked by .1, .2.

BLOCKS fz-usm.5: gives a real literal key (GroundValue) before we re-evaluate homogeneous map(k,v) typing and map keying.

RELATED FINDINGS (surfaced by the investigation, filed separately): the nil dual-typing inconsistency; the dead numeric-membership machinery.

VERIFY: lib+matrix green, zero warnings; report the five-types-to-two reduction in the commit diffstat; the four preserved distinctions pinned by tests.
title: Fold the four ground-literal-value carriers into one GroundValue + unify the two finite-or-cofinite Set containers
